resources.string: Sensitive values are masked in exported copies only. The archived original is never rewritten.
Request and response bodies, cookies, Authorization headers and tokens are never written to the log.
A device must be paired before any control command is accepted. The local network is treated as untrusted.
configurable redaction defaults need a settings port that does not exist yet
The event journal and its projections live in the private storage of this application. Nothing is written to shared storage.
Export bundles are written only to the location you pick in the system file picker; this app keeps no second copy.
clearing and migrating local data need storage ports that do not exist yet
